tells.1: Repeated 'so you...' benefit clauses tacked onto features ('so you know what to do and how to do it right', 'so you can see proper form').
tells.2: Every bullet uses the same 'X, so Y' construction, giving it a flattened, mechanical rhythm. It also has a vague filler claim ('unlocks additional features').
tells.3: Stock inspirational filler like 'guidance you can trust', 'keep your recovery moving', 'BUILT FOR REAL RECOVERY' and 'unlock more of what the app has to offer'.

reason: Version 4 has the slightly clunky, cliché-prone feel of a real human-written listing ('Never miss a session again', 'within 24-hours prior'), but its awkward legal copy hurts credibility. Version 1 keeps the clarity and warmth without Version 3's marketing filler or Version 2's monotone, so it's the one to publish.
